purpose: ClassAnnotation is a scripted Slicer module for manually assigning class labels (single or multi-label) to cases in flat or hierarchical image datasets. It writes results to CSV and copies the cases into per-class output folders. It is aimed at clinicians and researchers building annotated datasets.
summary: I read the catalog entry, both CMake files, the helper libraries, the README and LICENSE, and grepped the 3850-line ClassAnnotation.py. I did not read that file in full. I found no network access, no package installation, no subprocess, eval or exec, and no telemetry. File operations are local: CSV writes, copying images into an output folder, and deleting class or patient folders under that folder. The licence is MIT, and the CMake lists every Python file and resource the module loads. The issues are non-blocking. findOriginalFile skips any path containing "output". Class names are only partly sanitised before being used in rmtree paths. Hash errors are swallowed silently. There are no real tests. The catalog entry tracks the moving "main" branch.
